$comment: Traceability: approvals table single-transaction consumption (data-model.md, tool/approval rule). Exactly one reply per request-decision. On approved, ticket is the single-use execution ticket the worker must present when reporting dispatch (approval.dispatched event). The worker verifies action_digest against its own computation; a mismatch is treated as denied and the turn fails (ChangedAction). On expired or denied the worker must not perform the action; the worker's LiveClient onRequest callback answers accordingly and the turn continues or fails per the worker's fail-closed policy.

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

action_digest.description: Service-computed digest of the canonical action. The worker must verify it matches its own computation.

decided_at_ms.description: Server time of the decision, informational.

ticket.description: Present if and only if decision is approved. Single-use; the service rejects reuse.

title: service.approval.decision
